reviews.title: Only works 25% of time
reviews.text:
I am really not sure what is up with this app. I got it years ago and also paid for the premium since it is only $3 one time and not a horrible subscription model that more modern apps have moved to. However that is also the issue. I’m more modern apps. It seems this is sadly abandonware with the last update coming about 5 years ago! I will have to do research but I will likely move to a different app soon. 
When the app works, it works. The tracking is really nice and it has all the updates your package goes through. But it seems to work for me only 25% of the time. No idea why. Other 75%, it doesn’t get the data for some reason. At first I thought it was just international issues maybe? Like an anime order from Japan post or something imported from Australia or Canada? But no! It’s about a 50/50 on those too. My friend in Japan sent me something using Japan post, tracking worked! I order from a Japanese company, also Japan post, didn’t work. I order from a Canadian on eBay, doesn’t work with Canada post or ups. I order from Australia, Australian post and ups, it works. Domestic Amazon orders with ups, doesn’t work. Domestic orders with other Americans on eBay or other small businesses that aren’t Amazon, usps or ups, 50/50 works. What is wrong with this thing??? Thankfully again the old app purchases were only a one time thing and not a subscription model so I didn’t lose too much by just paying $3. reviews.title: Defunct
reviews.text:
Worked great, for a short while.  
First, the UPS and DHL packages stopped getting tracking updates.  
Then FedEx stopped.  
I kept it around for a while because USPS still worked/tracked.  
As of February 2026, even USPS stopped working/tracking, so now I’m giving up on this app.  
Yes, I paid for premium back when the app worked well.  
And yes, I emailed them via the in-app “send feedback” option.  
Nothing has changed/been fixed.
